title: Tool Frontend Resolution
description: Determines which URL (dev server or built bundle) should mount a tool iframe.
body: Where a tool's frontend is served from, and how. A tool mounts into the tool window as an iframe on its own origin. There are two answers for which URL goes in the `src`: In development, the tool's own Vite server, declared as `frontend.dev-url` in kaava-tool.toml. In a release build, the tool's built `frontend.dist` directory, served over the custom `kaava-tool://` scheme. Everything else — a checkout that isn't there, a manifest that doesn't parse — resolves to `Unavailable` with a reason.
